evidence_items.explanation: The study includes GPT-3 davinci and documents difficulty tracking changing box contents. It tests inference after training, so it does not show that training lost associations from training examples.

Experiments identify a binding mechanism in Pythia and LLaMA models. This limits any inference that language models cannot represent bindings, but different models and successful cases do not refute occasional training failures in GPT-3.

Controlled OLMo pretraining experiments show that gains from injected factual knowledge subsequently diminish. This makes training-related forgetting plausible, but does not establish entity-property binding loss in the GPT-3 training discussed by Marcus.

unresolved_gaps: No located study traces GPT-3's relevant entity-property associations from known training examples through its training checkpoints.
The GPT-3 behavioral evaluation does not distinguish failure to learn an association from forgetting it or failing to retrieve it.
The controlled forgetting and binding-mechanism studies concern other model families and later experiments.
